title: Onfinity Integration Connector Manifest
description: Declarative definition of one external application connector. The AI factory PRODUCES this from an OpenAPI spec; the Universal REST Executor CONSUMES it at runtime together with a user's stored credential. No code is generated or deployed per connector — a connector is a row of data conforming to this schema. Onfinity itself is described with the same schema (its actions point at VAAPI, its triggers are outbound event calls).

$schema.description: Optional editor association hint; ignored by the executor.

manifestVersion.description: Schema contract version this manifest targets. Lets the executor evolve without breaking older manifests.

key.description: Stable unique slug for the connector, e.g. 'stripe', 'hubspot', 'onfinity'. Immutable once published.

name.description: Human display name shown in the catalog.

version.description: Semver of this connector definition. Bump when actions/triggers/auth change.

source.description: Provenance — how the AI factory built this manifest. Enables regeneration and review/audit.

specUrl.description: Location of the source OpenAPI/Swagger document.

specVersion.description: OpenAPI version of the source, e.g. '3.1.0'.

specHash.description: Hash of the source spec; if it changes upstream, flag the connector for regeneration.

generatedBy.description: Model/pipeline id that produced this manifest.

reviewed.description: Whether a human verified the AI output before publishing.

rateLimit.description: Connector-wide default rate limit; an action may override it. The executor enforces this per stored credential, not globally.

paginators.description: Reusable named pagination strategies referenced by actions via { "$use": "<name>" }.

actions.description: Operations the platform can INVOKE on the external app (the 'do' side of a workflow step). Map keyed by action slug.

triggers.description: Events the external app emits INTO the platform (the start of a workflow). Map keyed by trigger slug. Each is either webhook-based or polling-based.

baseUrl.description: Base URL for all requests. May contain {{connection.*}} or {{auth.fields.*}} template variables resolved from the user's credential (e.g. a per-tenant subdomain).

variables.description: Extra per-credential connection inputs (beyond auth secrets) the user must supply, e.g. region, instance domain. Rendered into the credential form alongside auth fields.

defaultHeaders.description: Headers sent on every request. Values support templating.

auth.description: How the user's credential is collected, validated, and injected into requests.

fields.description: Credential-form inputs the user fills when connecting their account. Stored encrypted in the vault, scoped per tenant. Referenced elsewhere as {{auth.fields.<id>}}.

test.description: Cheap action invoked to validate a newly entered credential (the 'Test connection' button). References an action key with a fixed/sample input.

name.description: Header or query-param name the key goes into.

valueTemplate.description: How the value is formatted, e.g. 'Bearer {{auth.fields.api_key}}' or just '{{auth.fields.api_key}}'.

tokenUrl.description: Token endpoint used to exchange/refresh tokens.

refreshUrl.description: Refresh endpoint if different from tokenUrl.

clientCredentialsLocation.description: Where client_id/secret are sent during token exchange.

accessTokenTemplate.description: How the obtained access token is injected into API calls.

field.description: One input in the credential/connection form.

secret.description: If true the value is encrypted at rest and never returned to the UI.

request.description: A templated HTTP request. All string values may contain {{...}} expressions resolved against the runtime context: input.*, auth.fields.*, auth.tokens.*, connection.*, cursor.*, item.*.

path.description: Path appended to connection.baseUrl. May contain path params via {{...}}.

body.description: Request body template. For bodyType=json this is an object whose values may be templates; the executor renders it to JSON. JSON in-flight — no DB model is required.

pagination.description: Strategy for fetching all pages of a list response. Output items are concatenated and passed through as JSON.

itemsPath.description: JSONPath-lite to the array of items in the response, e.g. 'data'.

cursorResponsePath.description: Path to the next cursor in the response (type=cursor).

hasMorePath.description: Boolean path indicating more pages exist.

maxPages.description: Safety cap so a runaway list can't loop forever. The executor logs when this truncates.

retryOn.description: HTTP status codes that should trigger backoff+retry.

errorMap.description: Maps HTTP responses to normalized outcomes so workflows handle failures uniformly across all connectors.

messagePath.description: Path to a human message in the error body.

input.description: JSON Schema for the action's inputs. Drives the step-config form AND the mapping UI's source-field picker. The whole payload stays JSON in-flight; nothing is persisted unless the action explicitly writes it (e.g. an Onfinity 'insert record' action).

output.description: JSON Schema of the response, so downstream steps can map fields without the data ever touching a relational schema.

pagination.description: Inline pagination, or { "$use": "<paginatorName>" } to reference a connector-level paginator.

input.description: JSON Schema for trigger configuration (e.g. which event types to subscribe to, which list to poll).

output.description: JSON Schema of the event payload delivered to the workflow.

dedupeKeyPath.description: Path to a stable id in each event used to suppress duplicate deliveries (at-least-once sources).

webhook.description: Present when type=webhook; constrained by the conditional below. Declared here so strict additionalProperties recognizes it.

polling.description: Present when type=polling; constrained by the conditional below.

subscribe.description: Request that registers our delivery URL with the app. The platform's per-subscription inbound URL is available as {{webhook.url}}.

eventTypePath.description: Path to the event type within the payload, used to route to the right trigger.

verification.description: How inbound webhook authenticity is checked before the workflow runs.

secretField.description: Which auth/connection field holds the signing secret.

cursor.description: How incremental polling tracks position so each item is emitted once.

requestParam.description: Query param carrying the saved cursor on the next poll, e.g. 'created[gte]'.

responsePath.description: Path to the value (per item) advanced into the next cursor.
